title: Email follow-ups
description: Find emails the owner sent from Gmail that got no reply after a few days, and write a short follow-up for each

settings.WAIT_DAYS: days without a reply before following up
settings.LOOK_BACK_DAYS: how far back to look at sent emails
settings.SKIP: addresses or domains never followed up (the owner's colleagues, suppliers who never answer...)
settings.MESSAGE: the follow-up, in the owner's voice; {name} and {subject} are filled in
settings.SEND: send follow-ups (true) or keep them as drafts for the owner to send (false)
